items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Justin Sun says Tron's post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
items.summary: "We're ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time," Sun said in a post on X.

items.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
items.summary: There are global concerns following incidents at OpenAI and Anthropic, and fears have arisen that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.

items.title: Sam Altman-backed Bitcoin life insurer, Meanwhile, raises more funds
items.summary: The round follows increased international demand for Meanwhile's Bitcoin life insurance policies amid broader macro instability.

items.title: US plans to seize $1B in crypto linked to Iran this week: Scott Bessent
items.summary: The Treasury Department has announced several digital asset seizures related to sanctions on Iran as part of US sanctions.

items.title: New York permanently bars Celsius founder Mashinsky in $35M fraud settlement
items.summary: The agreement resolves a 2023 civil fraud lawsuit against the Celsius founder and permanently bars him from the cryptocurrency, securities and commodities industries.

items.title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
items.summary: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the "swap" definition, while an interim rule excludes casino-style gambling-sharpening the agency's claim to exclusive jurisdiction.

items.title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
items.summary: The Bermuda-based insurer, which runs entirely on Bitcoin, drew the funding from existing backers led by Bain Capital Crypto after a record year driven by demand from wealthy families in Asia, Europe and the Middle East.

items.title: Here's a Way to Predict When AI Chatbots Will Turn Bad
items.summary: Physicists at George Washington University say a formula can estimate when an AI chatbot will flip from good answers to bad ones, and early tests on small models back it up.

items.title: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
items.summary: A National Assembly committee adopted amendments taxing stablecoin swaps and crypto exits by wealthy holders, then rejected the 2027 budget's revenue section.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Quietly Rehearsing for the Day After an AI Catastrophe
items.summary: Executives are war-gaming the political fallout of a major AI-driven cyberattack and preparing to brief Congress fast if and when necessary.

items.title: Senate Democrat Presses Cantor Fitzgerald on Tether Ties and Lutnick Family Profits
items.summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal wants Cantor Fitzgerald to open its records on Tether and on how much Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's family has earned from its business deal.

items.title: Kalshi is investigating bets on Trump's press secretary pick placed before announcement: WSJ
items.summary: Three bets totaling about $173 were placed before news outlets reported Zacharia's pick and are expected to pay out roughly $9,600 combined.

items.title: Ether ETFs extend outflow streak to nine days as Solana funds snap record 14-week inflow run
items.summary: Spot bitcoin, solana, and ether ETFs all logged weekly outflows following last week's trading, a notable shift for some of the funds.

items.title: Former FTX COO says Netflix's 'Altruists' trailer 'made me physically throw up'
items.summary: Former FTX COO Constance Wang says Netflix's "The Altruists" misrepresents FTX's collapse and turns it into a love story.

items.title: Blockchain.com seeks CFTC greenlight for US prediction markets, crypto derivatives trading: CNBC
items.summary: Blockchain.com has applied for DCM and FCM licenses to offer ahead of a planned $500 million IPO.

items.title: Ledger investigates wallet drains involving CryptoBilis buyers; estimate tops $86 million in losses
items.summary: Ledger said it is investigating reports of fund losses from users in Southeast Asia who bought its products from reseller CryptoBilis.

items.title: US targets $1 billion Iran-linked crypto seizure, Bessent says 'we know where it is'
items.summary: Bessent's latest crypto seizure plan follows months of sanctions and freezes targeting Iranian assets.

items.title: BTCPay Docker users must opt into Tor at their next update to keep onion access
items.summary: Existing installations must explicitly select Tor at their next setup or update, even though existing Tor data is preserved. The post BTCPay Docker users must opt into Tor at their next update to keep onion access appeared first on CryptoSlate.

items.title: Newer AI models missed more payment fraud in Coinbase's benchmark
items.summary: A fixed historical replay found weaker fraud coverage across three model upgrades, while GPT's precision improved. The post Newer AI models missed more payment fraud in Coinbase's benchmark appeared first on CryptoSlate.

items.title: Being right about Bitcoin won't save your 3x leveraged ETF position
items.summary: Bitcoin's next recovery could vindicate your investment thesis but leave your leveraged fund deep in the red, because the fund's daily reset can make waiting a pretty expensive habit. Getting Bitcoin right and actually making money on Bitcoin are becoming two different skills, es

items.title: CFTC proposes a divide between prediction contracts and sportsbook wagers
items.summary: An event-contract proposal and separate casino-wager rule sharpen the federal classification boundary while leaving state-law access disputes unresolved. The post CFTC proposes a divide between prediction contracts and sportsbook wagers appeared first on CryptoSlate.

items.title: Luxor's reported 6-13% annualized Bitcoin yield depends on mining delivery
items.summary: Luxor's paired forwards can fix gross BTC receipts, while mining delivery, counterparty performance and financing terms still determine repayment. The post Luxor's reported 6-13% annualized Bitcoin yield depends on mining delivery appeared first on CryptoSlate.

items.title: Coinbase's Texas move gets a shareholder suit dismissed over Delaware-era claims
items.summary: The October 2 court order required a written board demand in this action, without deciding whether directors committed misconduct. The post Coinbase's Texas move gets a shareholder suit dismissed over Delaware-era claims appeared first on CryptoSlate.

items.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

items.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
items.summary: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

items.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
items.summary: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

items.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
items.summary: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

items.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
items.summary: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

items.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.
